summary: The candidate's useful GPU value and boundary coverage was preserved, but its nonblocking claim and lexical AST guard had the review's stated counterexamples. The consolidated tests now fail a blocking copy and follow module-local helpers. Prepared main already contains the runtime redesign, so no speculative production change was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before mutation evidence: both empty and multi-request GPU cases rejected the blocking D2H call contract. The mutation was reverted.
Passing-after evidence: 4 passed, covering transitive host-conversion detection, the helper-indirection boundary, exact D2H call semantics, pinned host results, values, and empty tensors.

gpu_execution.evidence: The exact candidate and consolidated regression executed real ROCm GPU tensors, D2H copies, HIP event synchronization, and exact host-value checks on HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, an AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950.

remaining_limitations: Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was assigned, not eight H200 CUDA GPUs.
TP8 coordination, CUDA/H200 behavior, GLM-5.1 execution, 80K-160K prompts, near-full KV pressure, and the original watchdog hang remain unverified.
The regression qualifies the EAGLE result-transfer boundary, call contract, and values; it does not establish that every possible cause of the production hang is fixed.
